title: Coral and the Extraction
author: Lena Fairweather
blurb: Oscar Nakamura, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
